title: Croatian Meat Kebabs with Italian Flair
description: A unique twist on traditional kebabs, combining the flavors of Italy with the heartiness of Croatian meat. These tender and juicy kebabs are perfect for a family dinner or a casual gathering with friends.

ingredients.name: 1 pound Croatian meat (such as pork or beef)

instructions: Thread the Croatian meat cubes, onion, garlic, bell peppers, and mushrooms onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, oregano, and basil.
Brush the kebabs with the olive oil mixture, making sure each piece is coated.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with additional oregano and basil if desired.
Optional: serve with a side of crusty bread or a green salad.
